[Unit]
Wants=network-online.target
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=notify
NotifyAccess=all
Delegate=yes
KillMode=mixed
Restart=no
TimeoutStopFailureMode=abort
ExecStart=/usr/bin/podman run \
  --name %N \
  --cidfile=%t/%N.cid \
  --replace \
  --rm \
  --cgroups=split \
  --sdnotify=conmon \
  -d \
  --publish 127.0.0.1:49152:3000 \
  --log-driver=k8s-file \
  --log-opt=path=/var/log/podman/%N.log \
  localhost/myapp:20260304120000
ExecStop=/usr/bin/podman rm -v -f -i --cidfile=%t/%N.cid
ExecStopPost=-/usr/bin/podman rm -v -f -i --cidfile=%t/%N.cid

[Install]
WantedBy=default.target
